methodology.checkWallTime: Includes the Node CLI wrapper and Go child process, from spawn to close. Diagnostics Total time excludes wrapper/startup/teardown overhead.
methodology.coldTransform: Existing benchmark-worker.mjs cold mode, four real TSX files; fresh process, timed compiler module load and first transformation, excludes process creation and source reads.
methodology.warmTransform: Existing benchmark-worker.mjs warm mode, three processes, three warm-up batches plus twenty measured four-file batches per process; no type checking.
methodology.incremental: Existing benchmark-worker.mjs incremental mode, one persistent session, initial check plus two discarded edits and six measured changes. Each edit appends a different export to AuthoringExample.tsx. Includes checking that file and emitting JS/map, not full-project revalidation.
methodology.limitations: Normal desktop machine; OS caches were not flushed; no concurrent task-owned compiler workloads during retained timing samples. CPU/heap/trace collection ran separately. One early interrupted sweep overlapped trace serialization and was discarded. Memory used is extendedDiagnostics, not process-tree peak RSS. Three repeats do not establish a long-term distribution.

lintDisabled.conclusion: No observed improvement in this single probe; keep lint enabled. Not a precise overhead estimate.

fullEmit.command: node scripts/native/tsc.mjs -p apps/example/tsconfig.json --noEmit false --incremental false --declaration --declarationMap --sourceMap --inlineSources --outDir TEMP/output --rootDir apps/example/src --extendedDiagnostics
fullEmit.limitation: Complete example type checking and JS/declarations/two maps written to disk, no bundling/minification/Vite.

profile.limitation: CPU samples sum work across threads, not elapsed wall time; cumulative entries overlap. Alloc_space measures total allocations, not retained heap or peak RSS.

trace.typeDeclarationObservation: Each of the two generic function types in Equal (core/dist/jsx-runtime.d.ts line 7) appears as the first declaration of 41,308 traced type records. WritableKeys mapped-property declarations also produce roughly 41,306 records each. These counts are traced type records, not the extendedDiagnostics instantiation counter.
trace.limitation: Single checker with tracing overhead. The 6.665-second Link event is inclusive and may pay shared-cache construction costs; not a per-Link fixed cost. Raw 223 MB type trace removed after extracting findings.
